data.reference_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE impact(symbol_id, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, 1, '|' || t.symbol_id || '|' || c.caller_symbol_id || '|'
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, i.depth + 1, i.path || c.caller_symbol_id || '|'
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN impact i ON c.callee_symbol_id = i.symbol_id
  WHERE strpos(i.path, '|' || c.caller_symbol_id || '|') = 0
)
SELECT i.symbol_id, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM impact i
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = i.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY i.symbol_id
ORDER BY depth, i.symbol_id;
data.sql: WITH RECURSIVE target AS (SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols AS s WHERE s.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'), caller_paths AS (SELECT c.caller_symbol_id AS symbol_id, 1 AS depth, list_value(c.callee_symbol_id, c.caller_symbol_id) AS path FROM code.calls AS c INNER JOIN target AS t ON c.callee_symbol_id = t.symbol_id INNER JOIN code.symbols AS s ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id INNER JOIN code.files AS f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND c.resolution IN ('same_file', 'imported', 'method_on_self') AND f.is_test = FALSE UNION SELECT c.caller_symbol_id AS symbol_id, cp.depth + 1 AS depth, list_append(cp.path, c.caller_symbol_id) AS path FROM caller_paths AS cp INNER JOIN code.calls AS c ON c.callee_symbol_id = cp.symbol_id INNER JOIN code.symbols AS s ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id INNER JOIN code.files AS f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE c.callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL AND c.resolution IN ('same_file', 'imported', 'method_on_self') AND f.is_test = FALSE AND NOT list_contains(cp.path, c.caller_symbol_id)) SELECT symbol_id, MIN(depth) AS depth FROM caller_paths GROUP BY symbol_id ORDER BY depth, symbol_id
